info.prompt: Deep within the neural cathedral's core, a hexagonal gaming board floats suspended in amniotic fluid, its Gothic-Mechanical hybrid structure throbbing with life. Dim red socket tokens wait hungrily along the periphery as the player's current streak makes the nearest slot bloom into crimson luminescence. Twelve sealed tiles scattered across the grid begin vibrating at different frequencies, their condition icons flaring brighter with each approaching trigger. A sudden unison unlock sends crystalline shards spiraling through the neon-lit chamber in slow motion.
